Silver and gold goods sell for more. Fertilizer and skills raise the odds.
Wild goods grow back every morning, and each season has its own.
Hearts grow with daily chats and gifts. Perks unlock at 2 to 5 hearts.
Orders pay more than the bin. Check the board every morning.
Fed, happy animals give better quality goods. Feed them daily.
Skills unlock recipes and perks. See Menu > Craft and Skills.
Perfect catches roll better quality fish. Stay on the fish!
